features.description: Add per-call deadlines to GitHubClient's gh shell-outs via exec.CommandContext, closing quorum objection P-1 (V18: defaultExecCommand uses exec.Command with no context, so a hung gh wedges the caller). Typed timeout error, 30s default matching the driver's existing _mc_bounded 30.
acceptance_criteria: A stub exceeding the deadline returns a typed, identifiable timeout error and returns promptly
Default deadline is 30s and is overridable via GitHubConfig
All existing internal/messaging tests still pass (no happy-path behaviour change)
MUTATION: reverting to unbounded exec.Command turns the timeout test RED

features.description: New internal/mission/comms: a Client wrapping messaging.GitHubClient with mission identity (name/repo/issue), plus RenderReport producing the <=400-char iteration report. Deterministic truncation, never over cap, never silently dropped.
acceptance_criteria: RenderReport output is <=400 chars for every fixture including a deliberately over-long one
Deterministic: same input yields byte-identical output
All four mission identities (v1, world, docs, motoko) resolve to the correct repo and issue
MUTATION: raising the cap to 4000 turns the cap assertion RED
MUTATION: making truncation depend on map iteration order turns the determinism assertion RED

features.description: cmd/ailang/mission_comms.go implementing 'ailang mission report --mission <name> --body-file <path> [--dry-run]', registered in main.go beside messages/chains/design-quorum. --dry-run performs zero network calls, which is what makes the later shell cutover safe to rehearse.
acceptance_criteria: --dry-run performs zero network calls, asserted with a stub that fails the test if invoked
An unknown mission name is a clear error, never a silent default
A post that cannot be delivered exits non-zero carrying M1's typed error
MUTATION: making --dry-run fall through to the real post turns the zero-network assertion RED

constraints.no_shell_edits: This sprint must not modify any file under tools/launchd/ or scripts/. Four mission loops are live and three run pinned driver copies that re-sync from origin/dev at every fire (v1 every 90 min), so a driver change reaches production within 90 minutes unreviewed.
constraints.worktree_required: Execute in a git worktree, never the main checkout: a v1 iteration runs every 90 min with bypassPermissions over the shared tree.
constraints.land_via_pr: Land via PR, not a direct push to dev.
